sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant seeks some time to go through the TCR.
2. Learned APP for the State has handed over a copy of the status report as per which, the victim has been contacted, however, has expressed unwillingness to appear, having got married.

3. Considering that the appeal pertains to Section 376 IPC, Mr. Arjun Mahajan, Advocate (Mob. No.
9810047321) is appointed as an Amicus Curiae (pro bono) to represent the victim in the present case.
The I.O. shall serve a copy of the appeal paper book on the counsel so appointed.

4. Learned counsel for DSLSA has handed over a copy of the report which is taken on record and submits that the compensation awarded to the victim has not been disbursed due to her failure to appear before the This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/10/2025 at 22:02:52 Member Secretary, Delhi State Legal Services Authority, Rouse Avenue Courts Complex, New Delhi.
He further submits that as and when the victim appears before the authority, the compensation amount awarded by the trial court would be disbursed to her.
Additionally, the I.O. is directed to apprise the victim of the aforesaid and hand over a copy of this report to her.
